_about: Hand tuning of the hats (docs/art/cosmetics.md). Wins over fit_auto.json, which tools/import_cosmetics.sh rewrites from the hat sheets. Per hat: width (hat width in head widths, front view), sink (how far the hat's bottom edge dips below the top of the hair, head widths), dx / dy (nudge, head widths), scale, rot (degrees, positive = the front dips); any of them per direction as <key>_<DIR>, e.g. sink_SIDE, dx_BACK, rot_FRONTSIDE. Setting sink here also replaces the importer's per-direction sinks.
_oct29: Overnight Oct 29, Part 4 (tools/hat_contact_sheet.tscn, _screenshots/oct29/hats_before and hats_after): every hat floated above the hair from the side, three-quarter back and back (the importer sinks were tuned on the front view). The back of the head needs the hat about 0.2 head widths deeper, the side 0.1-0.15; a first pass at twice that buried the eyes. The preview and the world place hats from the same anchors (checked cell by cell).

LEAFCROWN._note: Oct 29 redo: the wreath sat on top of the hair; sunk to the brow (eyes clear in every direction) and a little narrower.
